newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai says consumer prices rise 7.4 percent in '96.
newsitem.headline: Dubai says consumer prices rise 7.4 percent in '96.

text.p: Consumer prices in Dubai rose 7.4 percent in 1996, after an eight percent increase in 1995, the Department of Economic Development said in its first quarterly bulletin.
The cost of living figures are the first official data made available on inflation in Dubai, one of seven members of the United Arab Emirates.
The index for transport and that for recreation and education rose most steeply in 1996, by 12.9 and 12.5 percent respectively.
The housing and rent component rose 6.2 percent in 1996, after increases of 14.3 and 16.5 percent in 1995 and 1994 respectively.
Clothing and textile costs rose 7.8 percent in 1996.
